```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

Inline maths: is where the math equations appear in the sentence, for example, $y = (1+x)^2$.

Display math:

$$mean = \bar{x} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i $$
```{r}
prob1 = tibble(
  x = 0:4,
  p = c(0.15, 0.25, 0.05, 0.35, NA)
)

## long format
prob1
```

```{r}
prob1[5,2] <- 0.2

prob1
```

Add columns xp and (x-mu)2p

```{r}
prob1 %>% mutate(xp = x*p, "(x-mu)p" = (x-sum(xp))^2*p) %>% summarize(mu = sum(xp), sigma2 = sum(`(x-mu)p`), sigma = sqrt(sigma2))
```

```{r}
plot1 = ggplot(prob1, aes(x = x, y = p)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = x, yend = 0), color = "blue", size=2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  ylab("P(X=x)") +
  ggtitle("Distribution of X")

plot1
```
